summary: NORSK AMERICAN AKITA KLUBB (org. no. 914 338 913) is an association (FLI) based in Gjesdal, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2014-10-27. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Jørn Åge Seljeset Mjøs.
